method: beat sheet -> manifest; no generated footage, no extra shots

shots.cameraMotive: start on the silent bell and reveal its size before we meet the man who refused it
shots.transitionMotive: open on the object, not on an establishing shot
shots.line: Aquella noche, el guardián no tocó la campana.

shots.cameraMotive: let the three winters land on the keeper's face instead of illustrating a number
shots.transitionMotive: same night, closer: the object gives way to the man
shots.line: El pueblo llevaba tres inviernos sin oírla.

shots.cameraMotive: follow the apprentice across the square so the climb has a direction
shots.transitionMotive: cut on the action: the rope is already moving
shots.line: El aprendiz subió al campanario con una cuerda.

shots.cameraMotive: hold the rope and the bell long enough for the silence to become information
shots.transitionMotive: action to consequence: the rope arrives at the bell

shots.cameraMotive: hold both positions in one frame so the comparison is spatial, not narrated
shots.transitionMotive: from the object back to the two people who disagree about it
shots.line: Comparó lo que el pueblo creía con lo que vio.

shots.cameraMotive: close the distance so the keeper's silence answers the comparison
shots.transitionMotive: hard cut into the reaction: no dissolve softens the judgement

shots.cameraMotive: move into the two-shot as the explanation narrows to the rope
shots.transitionMotive: from the keeper's reaction to the mechanism he refuses to name

shots.cameraMotive: hold the overlooked apprentice after the line has named him
shots.transitionMotive: cut to the person the village did not look at
shots.line: El tercero era el que nadie miraba.

shots.cameraMotive: track with the rope hand so the overlooked third step is discovered by movement
shots.line: El aprendiz señaló la cuerda que faltaba.

shots.cameraMotive: release the frame to the graveyard and let the empty space carry the unanswered question
shots.transitionMotive: night yields to first light: a deliberate change of time and place
shots.line: Desde entonces, el silencio tuvo fecha.
